questions.prompt: Which statements correctly describe the capabilities and information provided by SEM?

options.text: SEM replaces the focused light beam of a scanning optical microscope with a focused electron beam.
Its spatial resolution and large depth of field are useful for studying rough surface morphology.
A surface image by itself determines both the topography and the complete elemental composition.
A BSE image provides the same quantitative chemical information as an elemental spectrum.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：两者都可逐点扫描，但SEM探针是电子而不是光。B（正确）：高空间分辨能力与大景深有助于看清粗糙表面不同高度的结构。C（错误）：形貌图不能自动提供完整元素组成，成像通道决定信息类型。D（错误）：BSE能提示成分反差，真正的化学鉴定和定量仍需适当谱学。

重点词：focused electron beam（聚焦电子束）；depth of field（景深）；topography（形貌）。
逻辑链：聚焦电子束逐点探测 → 信号形成表面图像 → 高空间分辨与大景深有利于观察形貌，但不能自动给出完整化学组成。

questions.prompt: Why does a shorter electron wavelength not guarantee finer practical detail in SEM?

options.text: Raising beam energy shortens the electron wavelength and improves the diffraction-only expectation.
In a bulk specimen, higher-energy electrons can spread farther sideways before generating the measured signal.
The detector assigns every detected electron to the same physical point where it was generated, so lateral spreading cannot blur an image.
A voltage setting must balance the wavelength benefit against the size of the signal-generating region.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：高束能使波长缩短，这是瑞利分辨率思路中的有利因素。B（正确）：但常规SEM厚样品内的相互作用体积可随束能增大，横向扩展使信号不再只来自束斑下极小区域。C（错误）：图像按入射束的扫描位置赋值，不能将来自较宽区域的信号重新定位到其真实产生点。D（正确）：实际选束能要平衡短波长与横向扩展等限制，不是越高越好。

重点词：wavelength（波长）；interaction volume（相互作用体积）；lateral spread（横向扩展）。
逻辑链：束能升高 → 波长变短，同时厚样品内横向扩展可能增大 → 实际分辨率取决于两者及其他限制的平衡。

questions.prompt: Which SEM component–function matches are correct?

options.text: Electron gun: supplies electrons; accelerator: sets beam energy and influences interaction depth.
Condenser lenses: control electron illumination; objective lens: controls focus and influences resolution.
Scan coils: control beam position and scanned area, thereby affecting magnification.
Detectors and readout: associate measured signal intensity with raster positions to construct the image.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：电子枪是电子源；加速器设置动能，进而影响电子进入材料的深度。
B（正确）：课件分别把聚光镜对应电子照明，把物镜对应聚焦和分辨率。
C（正确）：计算机通过扫描线圈偏转束斑，控制逐点扫描的位置及视场大小。
D（正确）：探测强度与扫描位置同步，每个位置的信号构成一个像素，由控制读出系统形成图像。

重点词：electron gun（电子枪）；scan coils（扫描线圈）；objective lens（物镜）。
逻辑链：电子源供束、加速器定束能 → 透镜聚焦与扫描线圈定位 → 探测器把位置相关强度交给读出系统形成图像。

questions.prompt: Which statements about SEM raster acquisition are supported by the lecture?

options.text: The frame is assembled serially, although raster acquisition can still be fast.
A slower scan can improve signal-to-noise ratio by allowing more signal collection at each position.
In the illustrated raster, flyback contributes image data in the same way as the forward scan.
All raster positions must be exposed simultaneously before any pixel intensity is recorded.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：SEM逐点建立像素，逐点采集仍可实现较快成像。B（正确）：较慢扫描允许每个位置积累更多信号，可改善信噪比。C（错误）：课件示意中有效数据来自正向扫描，回扫应与之区分。D（错误）：逐点扫描不是全视场同时曝光，每个位置的强度随束斑扫描获得。

重点词：raster scan（光栅扫描）；dwell（驻留）；signal-to-noise ratio（信噪比）。
逻辑链：束斑逐点驻留采集 → 每点信号构成像素 → 适当放慢扫描可提高信号积累与信噪比。

questions.prompt: An operator surveys a large specimen and then zooms into one feature. Which interpretations are justified?

options.text: Reducing the scanned specimen area at fixed display size increases magnification, without itself guaranteeing newly resolved detail.
SEM navigation is restricted to the same small fixed field in the way described for scanning-probe exploration.
Changing the scan area necessarily changes the kinetic energy of every electron.
Increasing displayed magnification alone removes the specimen interaction-volume limit.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：扫描范围变小会增大显示倍率，但样品内横向扩展等分辨率限制仍在；倍率不等于新增空间信息。
B（错误）：课件把容易放大、缩小和移动至其他位置作为SEM相对SPM大范围探索的优势。
C（错误）：扫描区域由扫描线圈控制，束能由加速器设置，是不同控制量。
D（错误）：把图像放大不能缩小信号的物理来源区域，也不会自动分辨更细结构。

重点词：magnification（放大倍数）；resolution（分辨率）；field of view（视场）。
逻辑链：扫描范围缩小、显示尺寸不变 → 倍率提高 → 物理信号范围并未因此缩小，新增细节仍受分辨率限制。

questions.prompt: Which statements distinguish beam current, beam energy and their practical consequences?

options.text: Increasing current at fixed energy increases the electron arrival rate without changing what energy per electron means.
Beam energy concerns individual-electron kinetic energy; changing it can affect wavelength and surface sensitivity.
Reducing current can reduce beam damage but may make the image noisier.
Increasing current and increasing accelerating voltage are interchangeable ways of shortening the wavelength.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：电流对应单位时间内到达的电子数；束能固定时增加电流不等于每个电子能量增加。B（正确）：加速电压影响电子动能、波长以及样品内相互作用，进而影响表面敏感性。C（正确）：减少入射电子可降低损伤，但同时减少有效信号，产生信号与样品保护的取舍。D（错误）：电流控制电子数量，束能控制单电子能量，二者不能互相替代。

重点词：beam current（束流）；beam energy（束能）；beam damage（束流损伤）。
逻辑链：电流改变电子到达数量，束能改变单电子动能 → 信号、波长与相互作用分别改变 → 需要按成像质量和样品耐受性取舍。

source.page: PDF pp. 20, 42, 44, 50（PDF p.44印刷页脚误标48/50）；SEM教程解答及电流噪声图：TEM PDF p. 8

questions.prompt: Which relationships between beam energy, specimen material and interaction volume are correct?

options.text: For the same bulk material, increasing beam energy can increase penetration and lateral spreading.
A larger nuclear charge can deflect electrons more strongly and give a smaller interaction volume.
Changing specimen composition cannot change electron trajectories if the accelerating voltage is fixed.
The smallest interaction volume is the only factor that determines the final SEM resolution.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：同种厚样品中，高能电子通常深入更深、横向扩展更大。B（正确）：核电荷较大时对快电子的偏转更强，是材料影响相互作用体积的原因。C（错误）：束能相同也不能忽略样品元素、核电荷带来的散射差别。D（错误）：小相互作用体积有利于局域信号，但波长、束斑和电子光学等仍可能限制分辨率。

重点词：nuclear charge（核电荷）；penetration（穿透）；interaction volume（相互作用体积）。
逻辑链：束能和材料核电荷共同影响电子轨迹 → 穿透深度与横向扩展改变 → 信号局域性和实际分辨率随之改变。

source.page: PDF pp. 36, 37；相关教程解答：TEM PDF p. 6

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly identify the secondary-electron signal?

options.text: SE are low-energy specimen electrons that mainly escape from a shallow region near the surface.
SE are incident beam electrons elastically turned back near sample nuclei.
SE retain energies comparable to the primary beam and therefore directly sample the same deeper region as BSE.
The positive charge of the SE detector pushes secondary electrons away from it.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：入射束激发样品价带或芯能级电子，低能SE只能从靠近自由表面的很浅区域容易逃出。B（错误）：这是BSE的来源；SE来自受激发的样品电子。C（错误）：SE能量低、直接逃逸浅；较高能量和较深信号来源对应BSE。D（错误）：负电子被正探测器吸引，不是排斥。

重点词：secondary electrons, SE（二次电子）；escape depth（逃逸深度）；surface-sensitive（表面敏感）。
逻辑链：入射束激发样品电子 → 低能SE难从深处逃逸 → 探测到的SE主要反映浅表面信息。

questions.prompt: Why can edges and corners appear bright in an SE image of a chemically uniform rough surface?

options.text: A larger fraction of the interaction region is close to an accessible free surface at an edge.
More low-energy SE can escape and reach the detector, producing topographic contrast.
The brightness proves that the edges must contain heavier elements than the flat regions.
Edge enhancement requires SE to escape directly from every point throughout the full primary-beam interaction volume.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：转角、斜坡和侧壁增加邻近自由表面的体积比例。
B（正确）：SE逃逸深度浅，侧面提供额外逃逸机会，形成边缘增强和三维形貌感。
C（错误）：即使组成均匀，几何形貌也足以增强SE边缘亮度，不能据此认定重元素。
D（错误）：初级束相互作用体积与低能SE直接逃逸深度不是同一量；只有靠近自由表面的SE容易逃出。

重点词：edge enhancement（边缘增强）；free surface（自由表面）；topographic contrast（形貌对比）。
逻辑链：边角具有侧面自由表面 → 更多浅层SE有机会逃逸并被收集 → 即使成分均匀，边缘也可较亮。

source.page: PDF pp. 39, 50；边、角、斜坡几何图及解答：TEM PDF p. 5

questions.prompt: Which statements describe backscattered electrons and their sampling region?

options.text: BSE originate in the incident beam and can be turned back by strong interaction near specimen nuclei.
Their relatively high energies allow a deeper sampling region than the low-energy SE signal.
BSE are newly emitted valence electrons rather than incident electrons.
The nuclear backscattering process taught here requires almost all electron kinetic energy to be lost.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：BSE是入射束电子，受样品正核电荷作用发生强偏转后部分返回。B（正确）：BSE通常保有较高能量，其信号来源比SE更深；这里重点是相对深浅，不要求背诵固定深度。C（错误）：将BSE误认为受激发的低能样品电子。D（错误）：课件主要以弹性核散射解释BSE，高动能可以保留，并非必须几乎耗尽。

重点词：backscattered electrons, BSE（背散射电子）；elastic scattering（弹性散射）；nucleus（原子核）。
逻辑链：入射束电子接近样品核 → 较强核电场使部分电子大角度返回且保有较高能量 → BSE来源与SE的受激发低能电子不同。

questions.prompt: Why can BSE images distinguish regions of different composition?

options.text: A larger nuclear proton number can increase backscattering and produce composition-dependent intensity.
A single BSE grey value uniquely identifies an element without additional chemical information.
SE and BSE images of the same region can emphasize different properties: surface shape and composition.
BSE contrast is chemical because the detected BSE are emitted from the core levels of sample atoms.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：元素核电荷不同会影响入射电子被散回的概率，所以不同成分可产生BSE灰度差。B（错误）：灰度可提示差异，但精确元素鉴定需要适当谱学或其他证据。C（正确）：SE以形貌信息为主，BSE有成分相关反差，二者互补。D（错误）：BSE仍来自入射束，化学敏感性来自它们与样品核相互作用的概率，而非样品芯电子发射。

重点词：atomic number（原子序数）；backscattering probability（背散射概率）；chemical contrast（化学对比）。
逻辑链：核正电荷随元素改变 → 背散射概率与强度改变 → BSE显示成分相关对比，但精确元素身份仍需谱学验证。

source.page: PDF pp. 40, 41, 49, 50；核散射化学反差解答：TEM PDF p. 9

questions.prompt: Which distinctions are needed when interpreting beam-energy and aperture changes?

options.text: Changing beam energy can change SE contrast without proving that the specimen topography changed.
A smaller aperture and convergence angle can increase depth of field.
Depth of field is defined by the deepest penetration point of the primary beam.
Because SE directly escape only from a shallow layer, their image contrast cannot depend on the deeper interaction-volume changes caused by beam energy.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：p42的氧化钒纳米管例子说明成像条件本身可明显改变反差；低束能更表面敏感。
B（正确）：p43的几何图显示小会聚角使更大高度范围保持清晰，这是SEM大景深的重要关系。
C（错误）：景深是样品不同高度保持清晰的范围，不是材料内部电子穿透深度。
D（错误）：低能SE的直接逃逸区域与初级束相互作用体积应区分；p42明确展示束能改变仍会影响SE图像。

重点词：surface sensitivity（表面敏感性）；convergence angle（会聚角）；depth of field（景深）。
逻辑链：束能改变相互作用和表面敏感性，孔径改变会聚角 → 对比与清晰高度范围可分别改变 → 不应将景深、穿透深度和横向分辨率混为一谈。

questions.prompt: Which specimen-preparation choices are supported by the lecture?

options.text: A grounded conductive base, connected using silver paint, graphite paint or carbon tape, can drain charge; carbon tape can also support powders.
Non-conductive bulk specimens often need a thin carbon or metal coating, commonly applied by sputter coating.
Polymer or biological specimens may require heavy-metal staining for useful contrast.
Dry bulk and powder samples are usable, but specimen height should still be checked to avoid instrument damage.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：这些材料提供导电接触，碳胶带同时可承载粉末；机械固定与排电路径都应考虑。
B（正确）：碳、金或其他金属薄层可减少成像充电；不是每个样品都必须采用同一材料或厚度。
C（正确）：染色针对反差需求，应与为排电而做的导电镀层区分。
D（正确）：课件明确列出可用样品形态，并要求高度检查；镀膜或使用胶带不取消机械安全要求。

重点词：grounding（接地）；conductive coating（导电镀层）；staining（染色）。
逻辑链：样品导电性与所需对比不同 → 分别选择排电连接、导电镀层或染色 → 减少充电并提供所需反差，同时仍检查样品高度。

questions.prompt: Which steps belong to the conventional SEM workflow shown in the lecture?

options.text: Vent for specimen exchange and use gloves to help keep the vacuum environment clean.
Use the chamber camera and stage to position the sample relative to the objective, then pump down before imaging.
Begin with a low-magnification overview, center the region of interest, and perform voltage, focus, aperture and astigmatism adjustments.
A high-magnification image should replace the initial overview, because magnification alone guarantees safe specimen positioning.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：换样先放气，戴手套减少残留污染；随后送回样品并重新建立合适真空。
B（正确）：相机辅助观察样品与物镜的相对位置，样品台可移动或转动；空气分子会散射电子，所以常规案例抽真空成像。
C（正确）：这是p27的导航及主要调整流程；各调整有不同控制目的。
D（错误）：高倍率不替代全貌导航和高度检查；初始低倍率视野便于找到并居中目标。

重点词：venting（放气）；vacuum（真空）；region of interest（目标区域）。
逻辑链：换样后重新建立真空并安全定位 → 低倍率寻找和居中目标 → 逐项完成束能、聚焦和对准调整后观察细节。

questions.prompt: An SEM image shifts sideways through focus, while another develops perpendicular elongations. Which diagnoses are correct?

options.text: Rigid focus-dependent image shift calls for checking aperture centering.
Perpendicular elongations call for the stigmator, a multipole adjustment that reshapes an oval beam toward a circular beam.
The two symptoms establish the same fault, so aperture centering always replaces stigmator adjustment.
Ordinary refocusing alone removes the cause of both symptoms without any alignment change.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：p28把调焦时整体横向移动与孔径偏心相对应。
B（正确）：像散使欠焦、过焦拉长方向互相垂直；消像散器改变电子束形状。
C（错误）：孔径偏心与像散是不同失准，不能互换诊断和校正。
D（错误）：穿焦观察的目的正是发现对中或像散问题，仅把图像调到某焦点不等于消除原因。

重点词：aperture centering（孔径对中）；astigmatism（像散）；stigmator（像散校正器）。
逻辑链：穿焦时观察整体平移或正交拉伸 → 区分孔径偏心与像散 → 分别对中孔径或调整stigmator。

questions.prompt: Why is optical microscopy followed by SEM a useful workflow for a delicate biological surface?

options.text: Reflection light microscopy can provide an initial survey, while SEM reveals finer surface structure.
A conductive contact and an appropriate thin coating can help charge leave a non-conductive specimen.
Accumulated negative charge attracts and stabilizes the negative electron beam.
Views of fine three-dimensional structure can help investigate an optical function without directly identifying a pigment.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：课件蝶翼案例先用光学明场看整体鳞片，再用SEM看更细结构，体现分辨能力和视场的互补。B（正确）：导电安装与合适镀层减少电荷积累，作用是排电，不是要求背诵特定案例厚度。C（错误）：积累负电会排斥负电子束，引起闪烁或扫描畸变。D（正确）：细微三维结构可与光扩散等功能联系，但SEM形貌图本身不等同于颜料的化学鉴定。

重点词：reflection bright field（反射明场）；conductive coating（导电镀层）；light diffuser（光扩散结构）。
逻辑链：光镜定位整体结构 → 导电安装与合适镀层帮助SEM稳定观察细节 → 三维形貌可用于理解光学功能，但不直接鉴定化学色素。

questions.prompt: Which interpretations of changes in previously scanned regions are justified?

options.text: Polymer swelling or shrinkage, heating and etching can be beam damage; reducing beam current is the suggested remedy.
A hydrocarbon residue can polymerize under irradiation, so avoiding organic residue addresses contamination.
A persistent dark patch does not by itself prove charging rather than contamination or physical damage.
Conductive grounding alone removes the organic residue responsible for irradiation-induced contamination.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：课件将这些现象列为束流损伤，明确建议降低电流。
B（正确）：污染是表面残留在电子束下发生聚合，与电荷简单积累或调焦失准不同。
C（正确）：课件展示多种已扫描区域伪影，应结合机制判断，不能只按一个明暗症状作唯一归因。
D（错误）：接地改善排电，不能自动去除烃类残留；不同伪影需要针对性措施。

重点词：beam damage（束损伤）；hydrocarbon（烃类）；contamination（污染）。
逻辑链：束流可改变材料，也可使残留烃聚合 → 扫描区出现形变或污染痕迹 → 按机制降低束流、保持清洁，而非只靠接地。

source.page: PDF p. 44（PDF p.44印刷页脚误标48/50）

questions.prompt: An insulating specimen flickers and the scan is distorted. Which proposals address the charging mechanism?

options.text: Provide a path for accumulated electrons to leave, or use suitable ESEM charge neutralization when coating is unsuitable.
Switch from SE to BSE detection and assume that unchanged specimen preparation can no longer charge.
Treat the distortion as proof of aperture decentering, even if it is unrelated to changing focus.
Use conductive coating only to improve focus, because charge accumulation cannot deflect a beam.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：非导电区域负电积累可排斥束流；接地/导电层用于排电，ESEM则通过正气体离子中和，适用于不能镀膜等情况。
B（错误）：换探测通道并不建立电荷排流或中和机制，不能保证消除充电。
C（错误）：孔径偏心的特征是图像随调焦移动；充电畸变不能无条件套用该诊断。
D（错误）：导电镀层的关键用途是减少电荷积累，而积累负电正可改变入射束轨迹。

重点词：charging（充电）；charge drainage（电荷排流）；distortion（畸变）。
逻辑链：绝缘表面无法及时排走入射电荷 → 负电积累偏转电子束 → 导电通路或合适ESEM中和可减轻畸变。

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly describe the ESEM pressure arrangement?

options.text: Most of the column stays under vacuum, while pressure-limiting apertures and differential pumping allow gas near the sample.
The electron gun, column and sample must all be at unrestricted ambient pressure.
Pressure-limiting apertures actively pump away gas, so pumping between them is unnecessary.
ESEM succeeds by eliminating every interaction between electrons and gas molecules.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：ESEM不是整台仪器处于室内气压：通过限压孔及其间差分抽气，使样品附近可处于较差真空甚至环境压力。
B（错误）：这忽略了ESEM维持区域间压力差及保护电子束传播条件的结构。
C（错误）：孔径限制气体流通，抽走气体仍依赖差分抽气，两者功能不同。
D（错误）：气体仍与电子相互作用，而且后续正离子中和机制正依赖气体被电离。

重点词：pressure-limiting aperture（限压孔）；differential pumping（差分抽气）；gas environment（气体环境）。
逻辑链：孔径限制气体流通，孔间抽气维持压力差 → 样品附近可保留较高气压而柱体保持真空 → 环境观察与电子束传播条件得以兼顾。

questions.prompt: Which steps in ESEM surface-charge neutralization are correct?

options.text: SE and BSE emitted from the specimen can ionize nearby gas and generate positive ions.
The negatively charged specimen attracts the positive ions.
The positive SE detector repels positive ions toward the specimen, helping them neutralize accumulated negative charge.
Negative gas ions must add more negative charge to the specimen for neutralization to occur.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：课件把两类出射电子均列为气体电离来源，正气体离子随后参与中和。
B（正确）：异号电荷相吸，正离子向被束流充成负电的表面移动。
C（正确）：探测器的正电排斥和样品的负电吸引共同促进正离子朝样品漂移。
D（错误）：这把中和物种和电荷符号倒置；本讲机制是正离子抵消表面负电。

重点词：gas ionization（气体电离）；positive ions（正离子）；neutralization（中和）。
逻辑链：出射SE/BSE电离气体 → 正离子受样品吸引并被正探测器排向样品 → 正离子抵消表面积累的负电。

questions.prompt: Which applications are supported by the ESEM examples?

options.text: In-situ observation of wet materials and real-time gas/liquid/solid interactions.
Observing uncoatable archaeological material when finer spatial detail than optical microscopy is required.
Imaging a non-conducting ceramic or the illustrated unstained di-block copolymer without the usual charging preparation.
An insulating ceramic must always receive a metal coating even when effective ESEM ion neutralization is available.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：课件明确列出湿态原位观察及动态界面过程，并以水泥相关需求举例。
B（正确）：不能镀膜是ESEM适用理由；教程同时强调相对光镜需要更高分辨率时的选择。
C（正确）：示例包含非导电陶瓷以及无染色的共聚物层片，说明环境模式扩展样品适用性，并非宣称任何样品都无需准备。
D（错误）：气体正离子中和允许部分非导电表面不镀导电层，这是ESEM的重要优势。

重点词：in situ（原位）；vacuum-sensitive（真空敏感）；uncoatable（不可镀膜）。
逻辑链：样品需湿态、不能承受常规真空或不能镀膜，同时需要高空间分辨 → 选择适合的ESEM条件 → 扩展常规SEM难处理样品的可观察范围。

source.page: PDF pp. 45, 47, 50（PDF pp.45–48印刷页脚为44–47/50）；相对光镜选择的教程解答：TEM PDF p. 7

questions.prompt: What can environmental electron microscopy reveal during a wet, changing experiment?

options.text: Repeated images of the same region can follow hydration or other gas–liquid–solid changes over time.
Electron-beam-induced reduction can produce metal deposits, so the observation may alter the process being observed.
Using ESEM ensures that an electron beam cannot cause a chemical transformation in liquid.
A BSE image sequence directly gives calibrated concentrations of every dissolved species.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：课件盐晶体吸水例子表明同一区域连续成像可追踪动态变化。B（正确）：另一例中束流诱导溶液中金属离子还原沉积，说明测量条件可能参与过程。C（错误）：环境模式扩展样品适用性，不保证束流化学惰性。D（错误）：BSE记录散射强度变化，不自动构成全部溶解物种的定量分析。

重点词：time series（时间序列）；hydration（水合）；beam-induced reduction（束流诱导还原）。
逻辑链：环境条件下重复观察同一区域 → 可跟踪液体相关变化，同时束流可能参与化学反应 → 解释动态结果时需考虑测量对样品的影响。

questions.prompt: Which criteria are appropriate when selecting a technique from the lecture overview?

options.text: Analytical spot size and concentration detection range are separate performance dimensions; the smallest spot need not give the lowest detection limit.
The desired information—surface shape, local composition or a real chemical characterization—matters in addition to spatial resolution.
The technique with the greatest displayed magnification must be optimal for every material and measurement.
Every boundary in the overview chart is a guaranteed specification for all instruments and samples.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：总览图分别比较空间定位与检测浓度范围，不能由一个维度最佳推出另一个也最佳。
B（正确）：SEM应用及总结区分形貌、BSE成分反差和谱学表征，选技术应先明确问题。
C（错误）：倍率不等于分辨率，也不能代替检测限、信号类型或样品兼容性要求。
D（错误）：图表示不同技术的概括能力范围，不能当作所有设置和样品的硬性保证。

重点词：analytical spot size（分析区域尺寸）；detection limit（检测限）；information content（信息类型）。
逻辑链：先明确所需信息与空间/浓度范围 → 再比较设备信号和样品条件 → 不能只按倍率或单一性能选仪器。

questions.prompt: A rough composite has bright edges in SE, bright inclusions in BSE, and less fine detail at higher voltage. Which interpretations are reasonable?

options.text: Edge geometry can enhance SE escape even where composition is uniform.
Composition-dependent backscattering can make an inclusion bright, but its exact identity still needs chemical evidence.
A shorter wavelength at higher voltage prevents lateral spreading from reducing image detail.
The different observations should be interpreted through their signal mechanisms rather than one universal brightness rule.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：边缘提供更多靠近自由表面的SE逃逸路径。B（正确）：核电荷相关散射可产生BSE成分反差，但灰度不是唯一元素标签。C（错误）：短波长和更大横向扩展可以同时发生，后者可使实际细节变差。D（正确）：SE、BSE及束能变化分别涉及不同逻辑，不能把所有亮处都当成同一种信息。

重点词：signal mechanism（信号机制）；topography（形貌）；composition（成分）。
逻辑链：观察SE边缘、BSE夹杂与高束能细节变化 → 分别联系逃逸几何、核散射与横向展宽 → 避免用同一亮度规则解释全部现象。

questions.prompt: Which task–method matches are supported by the SEM lecture?

options.text: Use a light-microscope overview to locate a region before investigating finer surface detail with SEM.
Use SEM for large-area exploration with easy changes of position and magnification.
Assume a scanning-probe instrument and SEM offer the same ease of surveying a large specimen.
Choose the method with the largest displayed magnification without considering the required information.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：光镜整体定位与SEM精细形貌可以互补，课件蝶翼案例就是这种流程。B（正确）：容易缩放和移动视场是课件强调的SEM应用优势。C（错误）：课件把大范围探索方便作为SEM相对SPM的一项优势，不能假定二者导航范围与方式相同。D（错误）：应先确定形貌、成分或动态观察任务，倍率本身不是选设备的充分依据。

重点词：survey（概览）；complementary methods（互补方法）；surface structure（表面结构）。
逻辑链：先确定位置与目标尺度 → 光镜概览和SEM细节观察相互补充 → 依据任务而非最高显示倍率安排测量流程。

questions.prompt: A conventional SEM image of a fragile polymer becomes noisy after current is reduced. Which responses address the stated trade-off?

options.text: A slower scan can collect more signal per position and improve signal-to-noise ratio.
Raising beam energy is identical to restoring the previous electron arrival rate.
Reducing current can protect the specimen, while the acquisition settings must still provide enough useful signal.
Increasing display magnification alone supplies the missing detected electrons.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：更慢扫描增加每点的信号采集，可改善噪声，但仍需留意样品受到的照射。B（错误）：束能改变单电子能量，不等于改变每秒电子数。C（正确）：降低电流减轻损伤与保持足够信号之间存在取舍，应按目标协调采集条件。D（错误）：图像显示放大不能补充未采集到的电子信号。

重点词：electron arrival rate（电子到达率）；dwell time（驻留时间）；signal-to-noise ratio（信噪比）。
逻辑链：降电流减轻损伤但减少信号 → 调整扫描采集时间以改善统计 → 同时关注信号质量与样品受到的照射。

questions.prompt: A specimen must remain wet and cannot receive a conductive coating. When is ESEM a justified choice over light microscopy?

options.text: The experiment needs spatial detail beyond light microscopy while preserving a suitable wet environment.
Gas near the specimen can support charge neutralization of an insulating surface.
The mere presence of water makes ESEM preferable even if an optical method already answers the question.
Choosing ESEM removes the need to consider what information the detector actually measures.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：Tutorial强调湿态或真空敏感样品同时需要比光镜更高空间分辨时，可选ESEM。B（正确）：合适气体产生的正离子可中和样品负电，使不宜镀膜的绝缘表面也可能成像。C（错误）：湿态不是自动选择ESEM的充分条件；光镜若已满足观察目标，应结合任务取舍。D（错误）：ESEM改变样品环境与充电条件，SE/BSE等信号的信息边界仍在。

重点词：wet-state imaging（湿态成像）；charge neutralization（电荷中和）；spatial resolution（空间分辨率）。
逻辑链：先判断湿态与不可镀膜约束 → 再判断光镜能否满足所需空间信息 → 需要更细信息时考虑ESEM及其正确的信号解释。

questions.prompt: A coating improves the stability of an SEM image, but a scanned area still changes irreversibly. Which conclusions are justified?

options.text: Improved charge drainage can reduce flicker without preventing all beam damage.
Hydrocarbon contamination can still polymerize under the beam, so cleanliness remains important.
A stable image proves that the specimen remains physically and chemically unchanged.
Charging, contamination and beam damage are different mechanisms and may need different remedies.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：导电层解决电荷排流，不能保证聚合物形变、加热或刻蚀等损伤消失。B（正确）：表面烃残留可在照射下聚合，接地并不会自动清除它们。C（错误）：成像稳定仅说明某些畸变受到控制，不证明测量绝不改变样品。D（正确）：应按电荷、残留物与材料受束作用的机制分别诊断。

重点词：charging（充电）；contamination（污染）；irreversible change（不可逆变化）。
逻辑链：导电处理改善电荷稳定性 → 但束流损伤和残留物反应仍可继续 → 图像稳定不等于样品不被改变。

questions.prompt: A rough fracture surface has high and low regions that cannot all be kept sharp. Which response addresses this imaging requirement?

options.text: A smaller convergence angle can increase the range of specimen heights that remain in focus.
A larger depth of field proves that the detected electrons come from deeper inside the specimen.
Changing from SE to BSE detection automatically brings all specimen heights into focus.
Increasing displayed magnification alone extends the physical range that remains in focus.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：课件把较小孔径/会聚角与较大景深联系起来，这直接针对粗糙表面不同高度是否同时清晰。B（错误）：景深描述离焦容许的高度范围，不等于电子的穿透或信号采样深度。C（错误）：SE/BSE选择改变收集的信号，不自动代替电子光学聚焦条件。D（错误）：显示放大不改变实际景深。

重点词：depth of field（景深）；convergence angle（会聚角）；sampling depth（采样深度）。
逻辑链：表面高度起伏 → 不同部位偏离最佳焦平面 → 通过合适的会聚角扩大清晰高度范围，而不是把景深误当成穿透深度。

questions.prompt: Bulk specimens with different compositions are imaged at the same beam energy. Which interpretations of their signals are justified?

options.text: Equal accelerating voltage guarantees the same interaction volume in every specimen material.
Stronger deflection by nuclei with more protons can make the interaction volume smaller.
A material-dependent change in electron spreading can occur without a change in lens alignment.
A larger nuclear charge can influence both the interaction volume and the amount of backscattering.

questions.explanation:
A（错误）：相互作用体积不仅取决于束能，还取决于样品材料，不能由电压相同推出采样区域相同。B（正确）：课件指出较重元素的核质子更多，对快电子偏转较强，可形成较小相互作用体积。C（正确）：材料本身已是散射差异的原因，不必先假定仪器失准。D（正确）：核电荷既影响轨迹展宽，也影响返回的BSE比例；这是材料与成分相关反差的联系。

重点词：nuclear charge（核电荷）；electron deflection（电子偏转）；interaction volume（相互作用体积）。
逻辑链：材料组成改变 → 电子与原子核相互作用不同 → 轨迹分布及背散射信号可改变，即使束能和仪器对准保持不变。

questions.prompt: A conductive coating and an ESEM gas environment are considered for an insulating surface. Which comparisons are correct?

options.text: A suitable coating connected to ground can provide a route for accumulated charge to leave.
In ESEM, positive gas ions can neutralize negative charge on the irradiated surface.
Suitable ESEM conditions can be useful when the original surface must not receive a conductive coating.
Suppressing charging by either approach does not turn an intensity image into complete chemical characterization.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：镀层与接地连接提供电荷泄放路径，关键是建立导电联系。B（正确）：ESEM通过电子电离气体产生正离子，吸引至负电样品表面以中和电荷。C（正确）：老师给出不能镀膜的样品作为ESEM应用，方法选择取决于原始表面是否允许改动。D（正确）：解决充电是改善成像条件，完整化学表征仍需相应能谱信息。

重点词：conductive path（导电路径）；gas-ion neutralization（气体离子中和）；chemical characterization（化学表征）。
逻辑链：先识别负电荷积累 → 选择导电泄放或正离子中和 → 获得较稳定图像；再按信息需求决定是否另做化学谱学。

questions.prompt: A suspected buried feature is not visible in a surface SE image. Which conclusions or next steps are justified?

options.text: Its absence from the SE image proves that no such feature exists anywhere in the bulk specimen.
BSE can sample deeper than SE, but this does not guarantee access to a feature at any possible depth.
Increasing display magnification makes the SE signal directly sample the buried feature.
If the task requires a cross-sectional view of a buried layer, an appropriately prepared TEM specimen can address that different information need.

questions.explanation:
A（错误）：SE主要反映近表面浅层；一种信号中看不见，不能直接推出整个块体中不存在。B（正确）：BSE通常比低能SE的采样区域更深，但仍有有限的相互作用和信号形成区域，不是任意深度的探针。C（错误）：显示放大不改变信号产生和逃逸的物理区域。D（正确）：TEM可通过合适薄截面观察内部层结构，须按埋藏结构这一信息需求选择制样与透射几何。

重点词：surface sensitivity（表面敏感性）；buried feature（埋藏特征）；cross-sectional TEM（截面透射电镜）。
逻辑链：先判断目标是否处于当前信号可采样的区域 → 阴性图像不能越过方法边界作结论 → 必要时更换采样几何并制备合适截面。

source.page: SEM PDF pp. 38–40,49; TEM PDF pp. 15–20
